brief:
Israeli restrictions have stalled the delivery of more than 900 wheelchairs donated by two Australian charities intended for injured children in Gaza, according to ABC News reported by Middle East Eye. The wheelchairs remain undelivered as a result of the impediments.

The donations came from Australian charitable organizations seeking to provide mobility assistance to children in Gaza affected by injuries.
dek: Report: Israel stalls delivery of 900 wheelchairs for Gaza children Israeli restrictions have stalled the delivery of more than 900 wheelchairs donated by two Australian charities to help injured children in Gaza, according to ABC News.
title: Israel blocks delivery of 900 wheelchairs to Gaza children
